tasks.instruction: Every word below has a letter in it that you do not say out loud. Write the whole word. The dashes show you how long it is.

items.stem: A soldier in armour who rides a horse is a _ _ _ _ _ _ .
A piece of land with water all around it is an _ _ _ _ _ _ .
You blow a _ _ _ _ _ _ _ to start the match.
Someone who never tells lies is _ _ _ _ _ _ .
You use a _ _ _ _ _ _ every time you lift something heavy.
A big stone building where a king or queen used to live is a _ _ _ _ _ _ .
